notes: README.md is the English public landing page and README.zh-CN.md is its complete Chinese translation.
Both public READMEs begin with a linked table of contents and user-facing install/invocation examples.
Public documentation separates published-rule mode from custom-data rule derivation.
Published rules retain the paper ECFP2 interpolation/extrapolation provenance; applying them does not re-split the candidate table.
Percentage tiers are explicit. EC high/low denotes conduction/insulation regimes; the 5% tier is optional rather than a default.
Candidate identifiers are arbitrary and optional; PID is not required.
H-cap is calculation-only; results.csv presents the original star-containing repeat unit and rows.csv retains the audit copy.
The original upstream STCA scan/ranking/prefix-family algorithm is unchanged; only the skill adapter and documentation were revised.
Live platform publication and macOS host execution have not been performed by this package build.
adapter_changes: Calculation-only H-cap with original-star-SMILES primary output
Explicit percentage tiers in objective planning; no implicit strictness mapping
